title: Kindred — Share with neighbours. Find local help within 100km.
narration: Find local help. Share with neighbours. Post it. Just local. One free app, two sides to it. No money, no ads, no algorithm. Nearby neighbours will see it first. Ask — someone a few doors down probably has it. Informal lending and the odd swap happen too — that's between neighbours. One free app for your street — a place to give, ask, and find local help close to home.
